reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we introduce TestSuiteBench, a benchmark of 165 open-source applications, each with a structured and detailed specification of intended behavior, a reference implementation, a reference test suite, and on average 74 mutants.
